messages:
Lena: Quick favor — can someone pick up facilitation for this Thu ARB? I have a last-minute customer call. Agenda target: 3 RFCs (kv-cache tweak, rollout guardrails, perf microbenchmarks) + 15m triage.
Marco: I can take it if nobody else is tied. Thurs 4:30–5:15 ok? :raised_hand: 
Priya: 4:30 works for me, thanks Marco. I'll push pre-reads by EOD Tue.
Ethan: Heads up, one RFC author wants a 10-min deep-dive on kernel selection. Can we slot that after the first RFC?
Marco: yep, slotting plan sounds good. Can someone drop a compact agenda in the invite?
Lena: thanks! Suggested compact agenda -> paste below. Also can we do a quick poll for buffer if the deep dive runs long?
Lena: ```Agenda (45m):
- 4:30 (3m) quick intro + goals
- 4:33 (12m) RFC 1 + 10m deep-dive (kernel selection)
- 4:45 (10m) RFC 2 (kv-cache tweak)
- 4:55 (8m) RFC 3 (rollout guardrails)
- 5:03 (7m) triage & action items
Notes: authors should post 1-slide pre-read in thread; label PRs with "arb-review".```
Priya: I'll add the 1-slide for RFC2 to the thread today.
Dev: quick logistics: zoom link -> https://zoom.redwood/example and I've set a calendar slot for Thu 16:30. calendar-bot: Created event "Architecture Review Board" Thu 16:30 — attendees: eng-platform.ics
Marco: can we also add fallback model variants as an agenda subpoint under RFC1? Author asked.
Ethan: yes pls. Also request: whoever facilitates, ping eng-runtime on the thread at start so SRE can watch the perf tests.
Lena: noted. Marco, are you happy to follow the agenda and call for consensus?
Marco: yep, I'll facilitate and call consensus. I'll send the invite with the agenda and ask authors to attach pre-reads by Tue EOD.
Priya: thank you! One ask — can we shorten the triage to 5m if we run over?
Marco: we can compress to 5m and capture remaining as follow-ups in the doc.
Dev: tagging infra: @infra-sre FYI for perf watches.
Lena: Last thing — if anyone needs to swap, comment here by Wed noon so I can reassign. :thumbsup:
Priya: all good from me.
Ethan: all set.
Marco: invite sent, agenda included, I've set a gentle reminder 30m before. See you Thu. :v:
